en: For now I'm resting to recover
So I'm nothing but a burden to my brother.
My brother and I recently came by ship
here to Calstatt.
That's because we'd been told
there was plenty of work here
But we're outsiders, so at the factory we were
treated badly
and we only got the awful jobs.
note: Base for 206081/206705 (new line after #5213). In 206013/206636 it follows '...' on the same line: variant with leading space and no 'we' (parallel to 'we were treated badly').

variants.en: and only got the awful jobs.
and only got the awful jobs.

en: That's why Anton quit the factory.
Still, if they'd hire him again,
I'd want him to get a job that isn't dangerous.
We're outsiders, so the factory treated us badly
Still, maybe just being hired at all is
better than nothing, I suppose.
I was starting to hate this town,
but now I've made a friend like you, and I'm
so happy.
Therese
Wh-who's there?
I know that voice. It's
, isn't it?
What on earth brings you here at this hour?
I have a special medicine that will cure
your frail body
Really? Is that true?
Of course.
Now then, let me give you that medicine
You'll only be able to move at night, though.
note: Subject 'you' (Therese) restored: she will become a vampire.

en: Have you forgotten anything?
I've been getting hurt a lot lately
It's so strange.
I'm the Stanberg family's maid,
note: Built as 'I'm the ... maid, / Luisa.' so #5234 also works after #5327 "I'm the maid of this house," (slice 066, msgs 210794/211793).

en: Luisa.
Do you have a message for the master?
No, I'll call on him later.
Well then,
note: #1620 'I see.' only has trailing-space variants for msgs 209841/209886; in the other four messages the space comes from here.

en: please excuse me.
Do you have a message to leave?
I'll do my best again today.
please do come to the wedding.
note: Lower case: follows '{PLAYER_NAME},' (#223) on the line before.

en: No, I'll call on him tomorrow.
Today was nothing but mistakes again
Can I help you?
Yes, I'd like to leave one.
If I recall, you're...
I'm Luisa, the maid.
Ah, of course.
Now, about the message...
Oh no. I seem to have dropped it.
note: Shared by the stern (210068) and polite (211073) player branches; neutral wording.

en: Sorry. I'll come back another time.
I'll keep a good lookout for it here, too.
I'd appreciate it.
How's your work going?
Same as ever
But I'll keep doing my best.
I can't wait for the wedding.
you must come too, all right?
I'd really love for you to come
to the wedding too.
guess what!
The master gave his permission!
It's like a dream.
I don't know if Madam and I will get along,
but with Stuart by my side, I can do it!
Now all that's left is the master's decision.
I don't care what his answer is anymore!
Do you mean that?
Sorry. That was a lie.
I really want him to say yes...
I've made up my mind!
I'm going to tell the master how I feel.
Even if it costs me my job, I don't care.
Stua...
No, just knowing how the young master feels
is enough to make me happy.
Young master
Stuart
I love you.
note: Msg 210389 has no speaker tag; presumably Luisa to Stuart (follows #5277/#5278).
